answer.reason: The studio glossary in ARCHITECTURE.md names all seven phases (scheduled through faulted) as the studio's own firing-book words, and gives each one its own rule. So the domain owns these distinctions, even though they line up one for one with KilnwisePhase. The switch also folds them into a coarser set of piece statuses (WAITING, IN_THE_KILN, and so on).
